newsitem.title: USA: IOWA-S MINN FED CATTLE MARKET NOT WELL TESTED-USDA.
newsitem.headline: IOWA-S MINN FED CATTLE MARKET NOT WELL TESTED-USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not well tested on a live basis, compared to Thursday's close, USDA said. Trade was very slow. Demand and seller interest light. Offerings moderate.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200 lbs ld 65.50.
